heroLead: Perdido Beach is a small municipality near the Florida line where most families own modest, single-parcel mineral interests rather than the larger multi-tract holdings more common further inland in Baldwin County.
intro: Because Perdido Beach incorporated relatively late and stayed small, mineral ownership here tends to be simple compared to areas with more complicated development or timber-company history — usually a single family, a single tract, and a fairly traceable chain of title. That simplicity works in your favor when it comes time to confirm what you actually own, even if the underlying value depends on activity we'd still need to verify.

sections.heading: A Straightforward Ownership Picture, Usually
paragraphs: Most mineral interests we look at near Perdido Beach trace back cleanly to a single family purchase or homestead, without the layered corporate ownership history common in more industrial parts of south Alabama. That makes confirming your title one of the faster parts of the process.

sections.heading: Coastal Baldwin County's Leasing Activity
paragraphs: Exploratory interest in the deep gas trend along the Gulf Coast has touched parts of coastal Baldwin County over the years, though it's inconsistent from tract to tract. We check whether your specific parcel has ever been leased before saying anything about value, rather than assuming activity based on the broader coastal area.

faqs.question: How fast can a simple, single-family interest like ours actually close?
faqs.answer: Once we've confirmed clean title at the courthouse, straightforward interests like this often close within a few weeks.

faqs.question: Should we expect a producing royalty or something more speculative?
faqs.answer: It depends on your specific tract's history. We'll tell you plainly which category your interest falls into before discussing a number.

faqs.question: What documents should we gather before contacting you?
faqs.answer: Anything you have — a deed, a probate record, or even just the county and rough location — is enough for us to begin researching.

faqs.question: Would a small municipality like Perdido Beach have less thorough courthouse records than a bigger town?
faqs.answer: No, the Baldwin County Courthouse handles the records for every municipality in the county the same way, so the size of the town doesn't affect what we can find.
